name: Koro Sun Resort and Rainforest Spa
positioning: Independent resort on a 160-acre sanctuary in Savusavu on Vanua Levu, with lagoon-side, garden and rainforest accommodations and a spa set deep in the rainforest
best_for: Travelers who want snorkeling, diving and rainforest excursions from one base on Vanua Levu
Families who want a kids club and daily nanny service

facts.text: The resort sits within a 160-acre sanctuary on the island of Vanua Levu in Fiji.
Vanua Levu is Fiji's second largest island.
The resort is in Savusavu, a short flight from Nadi International Airport to Savusavu or Labasa airports.
Complimentary ground transfers are provided from Savusavu Airport or Labasa Airport.
The Botanical Rooms are set within lush tropical gardens.
The Rainforest Villas are set amid the Fijian rainforest.
The Rainforest Spa menu offers massages, scrubs, facials, manicures and pedicures.
The resort has a 9-hole adventure pitch and putt golf course.
The Jungle Kids Club's Bula Buddies program offers supervised activities for children aged 4 to 12 from 8am to 4pm daily.
Children aged 3 and under get 8 hours of dedicated nanny service daily.
The resort has an adult swim-up bar.
Latitude 17 Seafood and Steak offers seaside dining on the Edgewater Lagoon.

highlights.text: The Rainforest Spa is set deep in the rainforest.
The Koro Villa Collection offers private villas suited to a home away from home or a large group travelling together.
Dive Savusavu, an independent dive shop separate from the resort, offers diving from the resort's marina.
Guests can join a Sunday village church service.

considerations.text: Complimentary transfers from Labasa require a three-night minimum stay.
Excursions such as the Pearl Farm tour and the waterfall hike cost extra.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires longer transfer times.
